title: Salman's Long Search for Truth
paragraphs: Sebelum menerima Islam, Salman Al-Farisi melakukan perjalanan jauh dan belajar kepada beberapa guru agama. Ia mencari kebenaran dengan sungguh-sungguh. Perjalanannya sulit, dan ia mengalami masa-masa berat serta perbudakan. Namun, ia tidak berhenti mencari jawaban.

Saat Salman bertemu Nabi ﷺ, ia melihat tanda-tanda yang pernah dijelaskan seorang gurunya. Hal itu menguatkan keyakinannya tentang apa yang telah ia temukan. Kisah Salman mengajarkan kesabaran dalam mencari ilmu. Kisah ini juga mengajarkan kita untuk tidak menyerah ketika pencarian yang tulus memerlukan waktu.
answerKey: Before accepting Islam, Salman al-Farisi travelled widely and learned from several religious teachers. He was searching sincerely for the truth. His journey was difficult, and he faced periods of hardship and slavery. Even then, he did not stop looking for answers. When Salman met the Prophet ﷺ, he saw signs that a teacher had described to him. This gave him confidence in what he had found. Salman's story teaches patience in seeking knowledge. It also teaches us not to give up when a sincere search takes time.
